up: Retrieve canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (standard_value and standard_units) for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL5606461. Filter activities for exact values only (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL). Return one row per compound-activity measurement. Do not impose any row limits.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5606461' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
